name: mast_v8b_thomson_edge_boundary
author: first_agent
entrant_decision: 2026-09-30: variant 2 (keep the v7 solve, move the boundary to the Thomson edge)
rule_3: inputs and our own maps only; no MAST equilibrium field, demo shot or MAST score; the MAST leaderboard is observed only after a build and never selects
method: post-process the #949223 MAST v7 maps: per live frame with a scorer-read LCFS, Thomson Te profile smoothed as v7 (3 cm Gaussian); outboard (inboard) marker = radius beyond (before) the peak where Te falls to 5 % of the peak, when the laser reaches it; target = marker + 0.017 m outward (- 0.017 m inboard) = the DIII-D-calibrated median offset of the Te 5 % marker from the true LCFS; the map is warped in R about the axis, separately on each side, scale s_side = (target - R_axis)/(current crossing - R_axis), fading beyond the boundary as shape_edit.warped (fade 0.5 of the minor radius); two rounds (re-read, re-scale); sides without a marker are left as they are; frames without a marker unchanged
pilot: the same 40 shots as the v8 pilot (indices 0, 30, ..., 1170), all frames

acceptance.A1_edit_reaches_target: after the edit, the scorer-read midplane crossing lies within 1 cm of the target on >= 80 % of edited sides
acceptance.A2_no_contour_loss: scorer contour present after the edit on >= 99 % of edited frames

if_accepted: build the full MAST v8b archive (post-process of all 1206 shots), validate format and precision, submit with the entrant's go (DIII-D archive #952730 unchanged)
caveat: acceptance proves the edit does what it says; whether the Thomson edge is the true MAST LCFS rests on the DIII-D calibration and physics only
